SELECT COUNT(P.ID) 
FROM Patient P 
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID 
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 1 AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND P.SEX = 'F'
